title: RWB-AD-018: the job run record, the outbound-action answer and the right-enforcement path are not named in the target sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md (RWB-AD-018); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3.md (A2.11, A2.12, A2.14); Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P1 Recovery data engine v3.md (T-A.2 API-P1-001 to 003, API-P1-009); Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 (job_catalog DF-OPS-224 to DF-OPS-232); _work/msr/context/P1.md
section: s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.2; s12.7
description: The legacy monitor shows, for each job run, its business date, status, duration, the result of each check and both runs of a rerun. No target source names that run record: job_catalog carries 9 catalogue fields and no run column, load_run is removed with the inbound load, and no table is added in the Physical Schema. Three further values are unnamed: the operation of rwb-integration that returns the outbound actions the legacy AC1 shows, the enforcement path of the Platform administration right (platform session or the authorise contract of rwb-access), and the field-level detail of the run record.
evidence: LDM row job_catalog has DF-OPS-224 to DF-OPS-232 only and the TSD P1 T7 removal table shows load_run removed; TSD API-P1-002 refuses a rerun when the business date is not complete in v_ace_batch_status but names no run store; the P1 Ownership Map gives GET /admin/jobs and POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun but lists 18 tables, none of them a run record; no P1 or P2 operation row in the sources returns the outbound actions; DP-08 is not in the pattern list of this legacy key.
owner_role: P1 tech lead with the data architect and the P4 access owner
proposed: Adopt a run log in rwb_source_data with one row per attempt, keyed by job_id, business_date and run_no; show the outbound actions through the rwb-integration contract mock until that operation is published, with no build dependency claimed; take the Platform administration right from the platform session and keep MSG-P4-002 for the refusal.

title: RWB-AD-018: the contract baseline has no field-level detail for the run element and its boundary with the freshness resource is not written down
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P1 Recovery data engine v3.md (API-P1-001, API-P1-002, API-P1-009); Recovery Workbench TSD P2 Integration v3 (job_catalog); Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8; _work/msr/context/P1.md; RWB-P1-E1015-CON in the same story set
description: The OpenAPI baseline must fix the Job resource, the run element, the five run states and the two 409 conditions of the rerun. The sources give the catalogue columns, the query parameters, the response type names and the 409 causes, but no field length, no status list and no rule for which run a list answer returns. The freshness answer is owned by the sibling story RWB-P1-E1015-CON, and no source says whether the monitor serves it again or reads it; the outbound-action operation of P2 stays unnamed.
evidence: TSD T-A.2 lists Request and Response as Job[] and DataProductFreshness[] with no schema; the LDM gives job_catalog types but no run columns; the legacy story names three status words only in the screen state column ("Running; failed; waiting for the ACE batch; complete"); the P1 Ownership Map gives the freshness operation to P1 but the same operation is listed by RWB-P1-E1015 CON and APP.
owner_role: P1 tech lead with the solution architect
proposed: Fix a closed five-value run status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETE, FAILED, WAITING) with one date meaning each, one row per attempt, and declare the freshness answer as served here and owned by RWB-P1-E1015-CON, with no field restated.

title: RWB-AD-018: the alert thresholds, the panel baselines and the per-environment values of the monitor are not in the sources
source: Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4 (NFR-067, NFR-068); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3; Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 (ADR-023 observability); _work/msr/context/P1.md
section: s3 Preconditions; s7 AC5; s13 Solution plan; s14 Validation and messages
description: The deployment story wires nine panels and six alert rules. The sources give the 15-minute target of NFR-068 and the catalogue fields expected_minutes and alert_after_minutes, but no alert threshold, no panel baseline, no channel name, no replica count, no resource size and no retention value for the monitor. No source names the dashboard or the alert catalogue entry the capability must register in.
evidence: NFR-068 states only "alert within 15 minutes to the named owner"; job_catalog has expected_minutes and alert_after_minutes but no threshold for a refused rerun or a stale product; ADR-023 requires metrics, traces and logs per service without naming a threshold or a dashboard; no environment values file is described in the TSD.
owner_role: DevOps team with the platform observability owner
proposed: Hold every threshold, channel, replica count and resource size in the values file per environment, keep the 15-minute failed-job target from NFR-068, and confirm the thresholds with the operations owner at the wave 4 readiness review.
